hook.en: A man leaves his home at night, hides in a cave for three days with enemies at the entrance, then builds a new nation of different tribes and religions. How did the Hijrah turn a persecuted group into a model society?
hook.bm: Seorang lelaki meninggalkan rumahnya pada waktu malam, bersembunyi di dalam gua selama tiga hari sedangkan musuh di pintu gua, kemudian membina negara baharu yang terdiri daripada pelbagai suku dan agama. Bagaimanakah Hijrah mengubah golongan yang ditindas menjadi masyarakat contoh?

bigIdeas.en: The Prophet ﷺ migrated from Makkah to Madinah in 622 CE with Abu Bakar, after careful planning.
bigIdeas.bm: Rasulullah ﷺ berhijrah dari Makkah ke Madinah pada 622 M bersama Abu Bakar, selepas perancangan yang teliti.

bigIdeas.en: In Madinah he built the mosque, united the Muhajirin and Ansar as brothers, and set up the market.
bigIdeas.bm: Di Madinah baginda membina masjid, mempersaudarakan Muhajirin dan Ansar, dan mewujudkan pasar.

bigIdeas.en: The Madinah Charter was a written constitution protecting the rights of Muslims and non-Muslims.
bigIdeas.bm: Piagam Madinah ialah perlembagaan bertulis yang melindungi hak orang Islam dan bukan Islam.

detail.en: Ali sleeps in the Prophet's bed; Abu Bakar prepares camels
detail.bm: Ali tidur di katil Nabi; Abu Bakar menyediakan unta

detail.en: Hide 3 nights; Asma' brings food, Abdullah brings news
detail.bm: Bersembunyi 3 malam; Asma' membawa makanan, Abdullah membawa berita

definition.en: Migration of the Prophet ﷺ from Makkah to Madinah (622 CE).
definition.bm: Perpindahan Rasulullah ﷺ dari Makkah ke Madinah (622 M).
Orang Islam yang berhijrah dari Makkah.

definition.en: Muslims of Madinah who helped the Muhajirin.
definition.bm: Orang Islam Madinah yang membantu Muhajirin.

definition.en: First written constitution in the world, setting rights and duties of all citizens.
definition.bm: Perlembagaan bertulis pertama di dunia, menetapkan hak dan tanggungjawab semua warga.

question.en: Explain TWO lessons from the planning of the Hijrah.
question.bm: Jelaskan DUA pengajaran daripada perancangan Hijrah.

steps.en: Careful planning: a guide (Abdullah bin Uraiqit) and an unexpected route were chosen.
steps.bm: Perancangan teliti: penunjuk jalan (Abdullah bin Uraiqit) dan laluan yang tidak dijangka dipilih.

steps.en: Teamwork and trust: Ali, Abu Bakar, Asma' and Abdullah each had a role.
steps.bm: Kerja berpasukan dan amanah: Ali, Abu Bakar, Asma' dan Abdullah masing-masing ada peranan.

answer.en: Even with Allah's promise, the Prophet ﷺ planned carefully — effort plus tawakal.
answer.bm: Walaupun dijanjikan pertolongan Allah, Rasulullah ﷺ tetap merancang dengan teliti — usaha serta tawakal.

prompt.en: The Hijrah took place in…
prompt.bm: Peristiwa Hijrah berlaku pada…

explanation.en: It marks the start of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar.
explanation.bm: Ia menandakan permulaan kalendar Hijrah.

prompt.en: Who accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang menemani Rasulullah ﷺ dalam Hijrah?

explanation.en: Abu Bakar was his companion in the cave (at-Taubah: 40).
explanation.bm: Abu Bakar teman baginda di dalam gua (at-Taubah: 40).

prompt.en: Who slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the Hijrah?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang tidur di katil Rasulullah ﷺ pada malam Hijrah?

explanation.en: Ali also returned the people's trusts (amanah) the Prophet ﷺ held.
explanation.bm: Ali juga memulangkan barang amanah orang ramai yang disimpan Rasulullah ﷺ.

prompt.en: The Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakar hid for three nights in Gua ______.
prompt.bm: Rasulullah ﷺ dan Abu Bakar bersembunyi selama tiga malam di Gua ______.

explanation.en: Gua Thur is south of Makkah — the opposite direction of Madinah.
explanation.bm: Gua Thur di selatan Makkah — arah bertentangan dengan Madinah.

prompt.en: The first mosque built by the Prophet ﷺ was…
prompt.bm: Masjid pertama yang dibina Rasulullah ﷺ ialah…

explanation.en: Built at Quba' on the way to Madinah.
explanation.bm: Dibina di Quba' dalam perjalanan ke Madinah.

prompt.en: Muslims of Madinah who helped the migrants are called the ______.
prompt.bm: Orang Islam Madinah yang membantu golongan yang berhijrah dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Ansar means "helpers".
explanation.bm: Ansar bermaksud "penolong".

prompt.en: The old name of Madinah was…
prompt.bm: Nama lama Madinah ialah…

explanation.en: It was renamed Madinatun Nabi (city of the Prophet).
explanation.bm: Ia dinamakan semula Madinatun Nabi (kota Nabi).

prompt.en: The Madinah Charter is known as…
prompt.bm: Piagam Madinah dikenali sebagai…

explanation.en: It set out the rights and duties of every group in Madinah.
explanation.bm: Ia menetapkan hak dan tanggungjawab setiap golongan di Madinah.

options.en: the first written constitution in the world

prompt.en: Arrange the Hijrah events in order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa Hijrah mengikut urutan.

explanation.en: Makkah → Thur → Quba' → Madinah.
explanation.bm: Makkah → Thur → Quba' → Madinah.

items.en: Ali sleeps in the Prophet's bed

prompt.en: Match each person with his or her role in the Hijrah.
prompt.bm: Padankan tokoh dengan peranannya dalam Hijrah.

explanation.en: The Hijrah was teamwork.
explanation.bm: Hijrah ialah kerja berpasukan.

right.en: Herded sheep to erase footprints and gave milk
right.bm: Menggembala kambing untuk memadam jejak dan memberi susu

prompt.en: Select ALL steps the Prophet ﷺ took to build Madinah society.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA langkah Rasulullah ﷺ membina masyarakat Madinah.

explanation.en: Non-Muslims were given rights under the Charter.
explanation.bm: Orang bukan Islam diberi hak di bawah Piagam.

prompt.en: What was the main function of Masjid Nabawi besides prayer?
prompt.bm: Apakah fungsi utama Masjid Nabawi selain solat?

explanation.en: The mosque was the heart of the Islamic state.
explanation.bm: Masjid ialah nadi negara Islam.

options.en: A centre of education, administration and community

prompt.en: Why did the Prophet ﷺ pair each Muhajir with an Ansari?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Rasulullah ﷺ mempersaudarakan setiap Muhajirin dengan seorang Ansar?

explanation.en: The Ansar shared homes, land and wealth.
explanation.bm: Ansar berkongsi rumah, tanah dan harta.

options.en: To help the migrants who left their wealth behind and to build unity
options.bm: Membantu golongan berhijrah yang meninggalkan harta dan membina perpaduan

prompt.en: Which group was protected by the Madinah Charter?
prompt.bm: Golongan manakah yang dilindungi Piagam Madinah?

explanation.en: It guaranteed religious freedom and joint defence.
explanation.bm: Ia menjamin kebebasan beragama dan pertahanan bersama.

options.en: Muslims, Jews and other residents of Madinah
options.bm: Orang Islam, Yahudi dan penduduk lain Madinah

prompt.en: Who was the final authority in settling disputes under the Charter?
prompt.bm: Siapakah pihak berkuasa terakhir menyelesaikan pertikaian di bawah Piagam?

explanation.en: Disputes were referred to Allah and His Messenger.
explanation.bm: Pertikaian dirujuk kepada Allah dan Rasul-Nya.

prompt.en: Which caliph made the Hijrah the start of the Islamic calendar?
prompt.bm: Khalifah manakah yang menjadikan Hijrah permulaan kalendar Islam?

explanation.en: Umar chose the Hijrah as the starting point of the Hijri calendar.
explanation.bm: Umar memilih Hijrah sebagai titik permulaan kalendar Hijrah.

prompt.en: Why did the Prophet ﷺ go south to Gua Thur first instead of heading straight north to Madinah?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Rasulullah ﷺ ke selatan ke Gua Thur dahulu dan bukan terus ke utara ke Madinah?

explanation.en: A smart strategy — trust in Allah combined with planning.
explanation.bm: Strategi bijak — tawakal digabungkan dengan perancangan.

options.en: To mislead the Quraisy who would search the Madinah route
options.bm: Mengelirukan Quraisy yang akan mencari di laluan ke Madinah

options.en: Because Madinah was in the south

prompt.en: How is the Madinah Charter similar to Malaysia's Federal Constitution?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah Piagam Madinah menyerupai Perlembagaan Persekutuan Malaysia?

explanation.en: Both guarantee freedom of religion and unity under one leadership.
explanation.bm: Kedua-duanya menjamin kebebasan beragama dan perpaduan di bawah satu kepimpinan.

options.en: Both are written documents that set rights and duties in a multi-religious society
options.bm: Kedua-duanya dokumen bertulis yang menetapkan hak dan tanggungjawab dalam masyarakat berbilang agama

options.en: Both were written by the British

prompt.en: What lesson can a new student in a hostel learn from the Ansar?
prompt.bm: Apakah pengajaran daripada golongan Ansar untuk pelajar baharu di asrama?

explanation.en: Al-Hasyr: 9 praises the Ansar for preferring others over themselves.
explanation.bm: Al-Hasyr: 9 memuji Ansar kerana mendahulukan orang lain daripada diri sendiri.

options.en: Welcome and help newcomers generously, putting others first (ithar)
options.bm: Sambut dan bantu pendatang baharu dengan murah hati, mendahulukan orang lain (ithar)

prompt.en: What is the deeper meaning of "hijrah" for Muslims today?
prompt.bm: Apakah makna "hijrah" yang lebih mendalam bagi umat Islam hari ini?

explanation.en: "The muhajir is one who leaves what Allah has forbidden." (al-Bukhari)
explanation.bm: "Muhajir ialah orang yang meninggalkan apa yang dilarang Allah." (al-Bukhari)

options.en: Moving from bad habits to good ones
options.bm: Berpindah daripada tabiat buruk kepada yang baik
